# Take Notes

Self-organizing markdown note app built with agentic workflow.

The app retrieves related note sections, asks agent to propose destination and markdown update, then requires user approval before writing to disk.

## Screenshots

![Take Notes application with agent trace, note composer, proposal, and markdown map](assets/TN_app.png)

![Agent-generated markdown proposal with destination controls and approval actions](assets/TN_proposal.png)

## Architecture

See [System Design](docs/system-design.md) for HLD & LLD.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    UI["Browser UI"] --> API["FastAPI"]
    API --> AGENT["Microsoft Agent Framework"]
    AGENT -->|chooses tools iteratively| TOOLS["Read-only Note Tools"]
    TOOLS --> RAG["Azure Embeddings + Chroma"]
    RAG --> NOTES[("Markdown Notes")]
    AGENT <-->|generation| FOUNDRY["Azure AI Foundry"]
    API -->|approved writes only| NOTES
    MCP["FastMCP Server"] --> TOOLS
```

Key behavior:

- Agent dynamically chooses search, similarity, outline, and file-map tools.
- Runs are bounded by model-round, tool-call, error, and timeout limits.
- Ambiguous notes pause for inline user clarification, then resume same workflow.
- Markdown sections are embedded with an Azure embedding model and stored in Chroma.
- Changed sections are re-embedded; deleted sections are removed from the index.
- Lexical retrieval is used when vector retrieval is unavailable.
- Normalized relevance score of at least `0.80` is required to recommend appending.
- Only approved proposals can reach markdown writer.


## Stack

Python, FastAPI, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry, FastMCP, Chroma,
Pydantic, vanilla JavaScript, and `uv`.

## Setup

```bash
uv sync --extra dev --extra foundry --extra rag
cp .env.temp .env
```

Configure `.env`:

```dotenv
TAKE_NOTES_AGENT_MODE=foundry
TAKE_NOTES_RAG_MODE=vector

FOUNDRY_MODEL_ENDPOINT=https://your-resource.services.ai.azure.com/openai/v1
FOUNDRY_MODEL_NAME=your-chat-deployment
AZURE_FOUNDRY_API_KEY=your-key

FOUNDRY_EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT=https://your-resource.services.ai.azure.com
FOUNDRY_EMBEDDING_MODEL=your-embedding-deployment
```

Start application

```bash
uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

Optionally run standalone MCP server

```bash
uv run python -m app.mcp_server
```

Open [http://127.0.0.1:8000](http://127.0.0.1:8000)

## Workflow

1. Enter unstructured note.
2. Agent chooses and calls read-only knowledge tools.
3. It asks for clarification when evidence or intent is ambiguous.
4. It generates structured placement proposal with Azure AI Foundry.
5. Review or revise action, folder, file, section, and markdown.
6. Approve write or reject it.

## Tests

```bash
uv run pytest
```

Tests cover vector indexing, semantic retrieval, incremental updates, stale-vector
deletion, lexical fallback, placement thresholds, and markdown writes.

## Local Data

- `notes/`: local markdown source of truth; ignored by Git by default
- `.take-notes/`: proposal history and Chroma index
- `.env`: credentials
